### B384433 — The bridge could still lose a description SILENTLY: nothing asserted that a regenerated file keeps them `[Infra / CI]` (task) #infra #testing  *(filed 2026-08-13 on the owner's instruction, immediately after B384432. Minted **B384433** from this branch's reserved block B384432–B384447 against `origin/main` b74ab0c. DEDUPE-FIRST — searched Open / ⏳ Verify / Done across `resolve-ledgers`, `B296224`, `B384432`, `MAP.md`, `build-map`, `mapDrift`, `description`, `post-condition`: **B384432 is the FIX and this is the GUARD FOR IT**, filed separately because they fail independently — the seed can be correct today and regress tomorrow, and B384432's tests pin the seed RULE while nothing pinned the PROPERTY. Net-new.)*
`[x]` **✅ DONE 2026-08-13 — a bridge run that comes back with fewer described paths is REFUSED, at the point the loss happens, and the guard is mutation-proven against the real PR #978 data. `Verify: sandbox`.**
- Verify: sandbox — a merge-resolution guard with no runtime surface; unit suite + the mutation runs are the whole proof.
- Origin: the owner's instruction, 2026-08-13, verbatim: *"assert the description count never decreases across a bridge run, and mutation-check that guard — break it deliberately, confirm red, say what the mutation was."*
- **⛔ WHY THE FIX ALONE WAS NOT ENOUGH, which is the owner's point and it is correct.** B384432 corrected the seed, but the failure it replaced was **SILENT**: the bridge printed `✅ … MAP.md (regenerated)` while dropping 48 of `main`'s one-liners, and only an unrelated `--check` in a later step noticed. A future change to `build-map.mjs`'s preservation, to the `- **\`path\`** — desc` line format, or to the seed re-opens exactly that hole **with the report still green**. That is the blind-instrument class sitting inside the fix for it.
- **THE GUARD: `lostDescriptions(ours, theirs, result)`, wired as a POST-CONDITION** in the same shape as the script's existing duplicate-id rollback — check the RESULT, and refuse rather than report a success it did not earn (LOUD-FAILURE). On a loss the ledgers are restored, nothing is staged, and the message names the file and the paths.
- **⛔ THE PRECISION THAT STOPS IT BEING A NUISANCE.** A path legitimately vanishes when the merge DELETED or RENAMED that file, and the fresh scan is right to drop it. So the check is scoped to paths the regenerated file **STILL LISTS** — described before, present now, `TODO — describe` now. That is exactly the PR #978 shape (all 48 files still existed; only their descriptions were gone) and it cannot fire on a deletion.
- **⛔ MUTATION-PROVEN TWICE, AND THE FIRST ONE IS AGAINST REAL DATA RATHER THAN A CONSTRUCTED CASE.**
  - **Mutation A — restore the pre-fix seed.** Driving `lostDescriptions` over the two ACTUAL `MAP.md` sides of the PR #978 merge (ours `d0728b1`, theirs `651849d`): `git checkout --ours` → **48 lost, guard RED**; the union seed → **0 lost, guard GREEN**. The 48 matches the count measured live when the defect was found, so the guard reports precisely the real failure.
  - **Mutation B — drift the line format** (`- **\`path\`**` → `- **ZZZ\`path\`**`), simulating `build-map.mjs` changing its output shape. **2 tests RED**, including the anti-rot check. This is the mutation that matters most: with a drifted regex `lostDescriptions` returns `[]` for everything and the guard becomes a permanent green that can never fail. Restoring the regex → 22/22 green.
- **⛔ AND THE ANTI-ROT CHECK IS PART OF THE GUARD, NOT AN EXTRA.** `parses the REAL committed MAP.md` asserts the parser finds >400 descriptions in the real artefact with zero TODOs, so a format change **reddens** the guard instead of silently disarming it. A guard nobody has seen fail is a guard that rots green (VIEW-INDEPENDENT-ONCE §6, same failure mode).
- **The real-data mutation is deliberately NOT committed as a test.** CI checks out at depth 1 and could not reach `d0728b1` / `651849d`, so a history-dependent test would pass **vacuously** — the exact rot this guard exists to prevent. The committed cases are its structural mirror; the real numbers are recorded here.
- **Sandbox evidence.** `test/resolveLedgers.test.js` **22 green** (+5): the PR #978 shape reported, the union seed green on the same two inputs, the deleted-file case that must NOT fire, the TODO-on-both-sides case, and the anti-rot parse. Lint 0 errors.
- Files: `scripts/resolve-ledgers.mjs`, `test/resolveLedgers.test.js`.
